## Change

Describe the observable behavior and why it changes.

## Documentation impact

List the canonical pages updated, or explain concretely why this change does not
affect usage, configuration, public contracts or operational limits.
Use `npm run docs:impact -- BASE_REF` to find related pages.

## Validation

List checks actually performed, including `npm run docs:check` when applicable.
Record material verification limits. Plugin behavior changes need their own
version, changelog and certification under the plugin standard.
